elsewhere.note: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”
But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows…
But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God’s Kingdom.”
Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything…
For this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as…
But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:
